boundary_traversal.cycle: all exposed Voronoi edges, one oriented cycle, occupied interior on left / CCW
boundary_traversal.edge_start_index: Stage A canonical cycle start from teacher protocol topology audit
boundary_traversal.packet_starts: every boundary edge index; cyclic wrap allowed

chord_arithmetic.length: symbolic sqrt(q); numerical evaluation never defines equality/exactness
chord_arithmetic.subblock_chord: for boundary vertices v_i,v_j use v_j-v_i, 0<=i<j<=k

direction_code.bijection_note: each exposed edge is identified by the missing-neighbor code; tangent is oriented with occupied cell on left

allowed_teacher_free_local_data: exact dot/determinant comparisons among local chord vectors

identity_readout_exactness.estimator: P_hat_{k,g}=(1/k)*sum_i C_{g(packet_i)}(packet_i) over all cyclic starts
identity_readout_exactness.proof: for a boundary cycle of N edges, each edge belongs to exactly k cyclic k-windows and contributes its raw edge length once to each identity window; hence sum_i C_identity(packet_i)=k*P_raw, so division by k gives P_raw exactly

packet_exact_record_required: ordered boundary vertices v_0..v_k in exact scaled-Cartesian rational coordinates
endpoint displacement and exact squared chord
all sub-block endpoint chord squared lengths q(i,j), 0<=i<j<=k

spatial_d6_canonicalization.canonical_key: lexicographically least transformed outward-normal direction-code word over the 12 corrected spatial-D6 actions; no internal cyclic shift of the packet is allowed
spatial_d6_canonicalization.normal_word_reflection_semantics: for a reflected group element g, canonical candidate word is [g(n_{k-1}),...,g(n_0)] in restored traversal, not naive free-word reversal without spatial transformation
spatial_d6_canonicalization.reflection: F(a,b)=(a+b,-b) applied spatially; because it reverses orientation, restore occupied-left/CCW by reversing packet traversal order after reflection
spatial_d6_canonicalization.rotation: R(a,b)=(-b,a+b) applied spatially; preserves traversal order

turn_word.from_codes: delta_i=(code_{i+1}-code_i) mod 6, represented by delta_i if <=3 else delta_i-6
turn_word.length: k-1 inside a packet; cyclic boundary turn outside packet may be stored separately
